patch_description: Replace the destination-order-dependent greedy attachment with an exact directed-Steiner dynamic program for modest destination sets. The DP explicitly evaluates every useful subset merge at each relay cloud, then applies reverse shortest-path closure to discover cheap shared trunks. This minimizes the union cost of broadcast links rather than merely minimizing the next attachment path. For larger requests, the existing scalable greedy strategy is retained, but corrected to treat already-installed links as zero marginal-cost edges. Invalid costs and unreachable destinations are handled without failing otherwise valid broadcast configurations.
